answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 23413 Country: India Title: Plz tel the sunnah way of istinja for females. If sme urine drops fall on legs the it shud be washd 3 times? Question: Plz tel the sunnah way of istinja for females. If sme urine drops fall on legs the it shud be washd 3 times? Answer ID: 23413 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 983/983/M=1431) The sunnah method of istinja is to do it sitting, the face or back should not be towards Qiblah. The nijasah coming out from back or front side should be cleaned with clod and then washed with water. If the nijasah exceeds an area more than the depth of palm i.e. more than the quantity of a rupee coin, then it is wajib to wash it with water. It is forbidden to do istinja with bone, unclean stuff and valued things. If the drops of urine fall on the legs it should be washed, if it gets cleaned by washing once it is enough; otherwise it should be washed thrice. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
